cover.prompt: An AI assistant running an ad campaign by fixed rules. On the left a tall chat window panel holding a few message bars and a checklist of seven square checkboxes, every one ticked. A single flat connecting line runs to the right into an ads dashboard panel with three horizontal budget sliders, a small rising bar chart and a run log of grey rows. One slider knob is the only cyan element. Two panels side by side, drawn large and whole, the group spanning the full width with an even dark margin.
